diagnosis.original_evidence: R84 gameplay shader HUD entered perspective finite-plane branch using any recent same-shader, same-pose original game c64 even when its producer was foreign.
source_trace: R51 stores game raw constant and semantic ownership at original SetVertexShaderConstantF write
R84 R30 obtains raw constant with shader, pose and age, previously omitting stored semantic identity
R33 submits R30-derived separate left/right constants and restores the original live GPU constant
diagnosis.root_cause: A shader identity and temporal window do not uniquely identify the HUD SpriteNode that created c64.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Original c64 is used to construct both optical eye matrices; wrong original owner reprojects another object's WVP into the full HUD field.
alternatives_rejected: Do not extend the 12-draw window, reuse already stereo-injected live c64, or globally retag unrelated alpha and world effects.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Native path now requires matching ScreenHud producer and queue node epoch before the finite stereo HUD plane.
